findings.title: Insurance and course approval wait on each other
findings.detail: T2 depends on T3 in the table, but the notes say "Kerry will take out the event insurance once the council has approved the course, because the insurers want a copy of the approved course map before they will cover us." That makes approval and insurance circular, so neither task can start.
findings.quote: Kerry will take out the event insurance once the council has approved the course, because the insurers want a copy of the approved course map before they will cover us.

findings.title: The plan gives two different deadlines
findings.detail: The summary puts the run 30 days after kickoff, but the task table says everything must be done five weeks after kickoff. Those deadlines do not match, so the plan does not have one clear event deadline.
findings.quote: Everything in the table has to be done five weeks after kickoff, by the morning of the run.
